topic: Adjusting vendor data for OOH analytics
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting the calculation of session duration and vendor data for Out-of-Home (OOH) analytics, specifically concerning new and existing client types.

*   **Vendor Data Cleanup:** It was decided that Vendor 0 and Apple should be removed from calculations for Latvia and all new countries. This rule needs to be implemented automatically for all OOH clients moving forward.
*   **Scope Limitation:** The scope of this automatic removal is limited to Out-of-Home (OOH) properties, excluding indoor clients initially.
*   **Implementation Plan:** [me] agreed to implement the changes starting with HQ specific accounts first. A mechanism was suggested to automatically flag a company as 'Outdoor' and apply the vendor exclusion rule for all new companies.
*   **Session Duration Review:** The conversation concluded with a review of session duration factors, noting that while local data showed issues, the real-world data provided better metrics when calculated manually per facility.
decisions: Vendor 0 and Apple should be excluded from calculations for Latvia and all new countries.
The vendor exclusion rule must be automatically applied to all Out-of-Home (OOH) clients moving forward.
Implementation of the changes will start with HQ specific accounts.
action_items: [me] to implement the automatic vendor exclusion rule for OOH clients starting tomorrow.
